name: Mentoring
overview: Mentoring in Scripture is portrayed as a vital means of passing down God's truth and wisdom from one generation to the next. The psalmist prays to continue declaring God's strength and mighty acts even in old age, emphasizing the responsibility to teach subsequent generations (Psalms 71:18, 145:4). Wisdom is cultivated through attentive learning and instruction, as Proverbs highlights that both the wise and just grow in understanding when guided rightly (Proverbs 1:5, 9:9). Ultimately, mentoring is grounded in the faithful transmission of God's word, which enlightens and brings understanding to the simple (Psalms 119:130) and unites believers in the knowledge of the one true Lord (Deuteronomy 6:4).
